title: A kb_feedback report repeated after its first row was delivered records no second row or own entry
goal: A repeated kb_feedback report (same pack handle and closed fields) after its first row was delivered records no second row: ql_capture.record_feedback's repeat check reads a bounded record of the feedback ids it wrote, which outlives delivery, not only the rows still in the spool.

run:
import os, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
os.environ.update(CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=str(tmp), CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=str(Path('.').resolve()))
(tmp / 'querylog' / 'spool').mkdir(parents=True)
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import ql_capture as C
f = {'pack': 'P-0123abcd', 'outcome': 'misled', 'judged_by': 'agent', 'lines': [{'line': 'public/claude/statusline.md:25', 'issue': 'wrong'}]}
first = C.record_feedback(f)
for p in (tmp / 'querylog' / 'spool').glob('tools-*.jsonl'):
    p.unlink()  # delivery took the row out of the spool
again = C.record_feedback(f)
print('first:', first, '| after delivery:', again)
sys.exit(0 if first[1] == 'recorded' and again == (first[0], 'repeat') else 1)
